prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Pet Restoration Notice Copy: Display an explicit hint on the sign-in screen informing users that signing into an existing account automatically restores their previous pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in restores any existing pets and saved progress linked to your account."}}
1: [choose_path, redesign] Path Selection Grid Layout Redesign: Redesign the path selection screen into a clean grid view displaying companion adoption paths side by side.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "grid", "headline": "Choose Your Pet Path", "body": "Select whether you want to adopt a classic companion or build a custom pet."}}
2: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Desktop Readiness Hint: Add an estimated setup duration and desktop status indicator to the waiting screen while pet files finish processing.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "hint": "Your desktop companion is being prepared. It will appear on your screen as soon as setup completes."}}
3: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Full Bleed Gallery Redesign: Redesign the pick_friend screen using a full-bleed visual layout to showcase available starter pets vividly.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "full_bleed", "headline": "Meet Your New Desktop Companion"}}
4: [finish, hint] Home Intro Desktop Controls Hint: Add desktop interaction tip text to the home intro screen explaining how to access companion controls from the system tray.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Right-click your pet on the desktop or system tray icon anytime to open controls, hide, or interact."}}
5: [choose_path, new_screen] Onboarding Story Companion Preview Screen: Insert a new introductory screen before path selection that introduces key desktop pet features and interactions.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "new_companion_overview", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_companion_overview": {"headline": "Your Desktop Companion Awaits", "body": "Discover how your pet lives on your desktop, reacts to your workspace, and keeps you company.", "button_label": "Continue to Path Selection"}}
6: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Lighting Guidance Hint: Provide clear photo tip text on the upload screen advising well-lit photos for optimal pet generation.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "Use a clear, brightly lit photo with a centered subject for best companion generation results."}}
7: [sign_in, redesign] Sign In Screen Split Layout Redesign: Rebuild the sign-in screen using a split layout to separate new account creation from returning user pet sync.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Sign In to Save & Sync Your Pet", "body": "Log in to link your pet to your account and keep your progress safe across sessions."}}
8: [home, new_flow] Waiting Screen Interactive Tip Carousel Flow: Introduce an interactive tip carousel flow on the waiting screen with automatically rotating tips on desktop pet usage.
   config: {"waiting": {"tip_delay_seconds": 10, "components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "text": "Tip: You can drag your pet anywhere on screen or set it to idle near your taskbar."}]}}
9: [finish, incentive] Home Intro Completion Welcome Incentive Copy: Update the final onboarding headline and body to celebrate completing adoption and unlocking companion features.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Welcome to Your Desktop Companion!", "body": "Setup is complete! Your companion is now active and ready to keep you company on your desktop."}}

verdicts.reason: Adds account restoration hint to sign in screen without violating onboarding rules.
Redesigns choose path screen while retaining both adoption and custom pet creation options.
Adds duration estimate and status hint to the waiting screen for a real wait process.
Redesigns pick friend screen using full-bleed layout while keeping companion selection job.
Adds desktop control tips to the home intro screen within onboarding limits.
Inserts a new introductory screen into onboarding while preserving all required steps.
Adds photo lighting guidance copy to the photo upload screen.
Redesigns sign in screen with a split layout while maintaining sign-in functionality.
Adds a tip carousel flow on the waiting screen while pet is being generated.
Updates home intro copy without mentioning pricing, discounts, gifts, or extras.
